note_evidence: The distorted bass acts as a continuous wall of sound (e.g., 0:11-0:19) and lacks the obvious, rhythmic ducking and swelling effect required to feel a heavy sidechain pump when the kick hits.
beat_evidence: A strong, steady kick and percussion pattern begins immediately at 0:00, providing an unmistakable and consistent pulse for players to tap along to.
loop_evidence: The track fails to maintain steady energy for a seamless loop, as the beat drops out at 0:38 and the vocal chops echo and fade out until 0:40.
